name: Node.js Generic + yt-dlp + Cloudflare
author: mohamadusta05@gmail.com
description:
A generic Node.js egg using centralized runtime and installer images with Python, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, and optional Cloudflare Tunnel support.

This will clone a Git repository or prepare the server for manual uploads. The Docker image provides shared system tools, while project dependencies remain isolated per server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e

STARTUP_HELPER_DIR="/mnt/server/.ptero"
mkdir -p "${STARTUP_HELPER_DIR}"
cat >"${STARTUP_HELPER_DIR}/startup.sh" <<'PTERO_STARTUP'
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -u

cd /home/container
export PATH="/home/container/.local/bin:${PATH}"

is_enabled() {
  case "${1:-0}" in
    1|true|TRUE|on|ON|yes|YES) return 0 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

if [[ -d .git ]] && is_enabled "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}"; then
  git pull || echo "Git auto-update failed; using the current project files."
fi

if [[ -n "${NODE_PACKAGES:-}" ]]; then
  read -r -a node_packages <<<"${NODE_PACKAGES}"
  /usr/local/bin/npm install "${node_packages[@]}"
fi

if [[ -n "${UNNODE_PACKAGES:-}" ]]; then
  read -r -a unnode_packages <<<"${UNNODE_PACKAGES}"
  /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall "${unnode_packages[@]}"
fi

if [[ -f /home/container/package.json ]]; then
  /usr/local/bin/npm install
fi

ensure_ytdlp() {
  if command -v yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 0
  fi

  echo "yt-dlp is missing from the selected Docker image."
  return 1
}

ensure_ytdlp || true

start_cloudflare_tunnel() {
  local cloudflare_dir="/home/container/.cloudflare"
  local cloudflared_bin

  cloudflared_bin="$(command -v cloudflared || true)"

  mkdir -p "$cloudflare_dir" || return 1
  touch "$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log" || return 1
  chmod 700 "$cloudflare_dir"
  chmod 600 "$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log"

  if [[ -z "${TUNNEL_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
    echo "Cloudflare Tunnel is enabled, but TUNNEL_TOKEN is empty." | tee -a "$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ -z "$cloudflared_bin" ]]; then
    echo "cloudflared is missing from the selected Docker image." | tee -a "$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log"
    return 1
  fi

  echo "Starting Cloudflare Tunnel connector..." >>"$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log"
  (
    "$cloudflared_bin" tunnel --no-autoupdate --loglevel info run >>"$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log" 2>&1
    cloudflared_status=$?
    echo "Cloudflare Tunnel process exited (code ${cloudflared_status}). Check .cloudflare/tunnel.log." \
      | tee -a "$cloudflare_dir/tunnel.log"
  ) &

  echo "Cloudflare Tunnel launched; check .cloudflare/tunnel.log for connection status."
}

if is_enabled "${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ENABLED:-0}"; then
  start_cloudflare_tunnel || echo "Cloudflare Tunnel setup failed; application startup will continue."
else
  echo "Cloudflare Tunnel is disabled."
fi

if [[ -z "${STARTUP_COMMAND:-}" ]]; then
  echo "STARTUP_COMMAND is empty; cannot start the Node.js application."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f /home/container/package.json ]] \
  && [[ "$STARTUP_COMMAND" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(npm|pnpm|yarn)([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then
  echo "package.json was not found in /home/container."
  echo "Set Git Repo Address and reinstall, or upload the project files before starting the server."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Starting Node.js application..."
exec /bin/bash -c "$STARTUP_COMMAND"
PTERO_STARTUP
chmod 755 "${STARTUP_HELPER_DIR}/startup.sh"
echo "Created ${STARTUP_HELPER_DIR}/startup.sh."

echo "Using tools bundled with the centralized installation image."
node --version
npm --version

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

SKIP_APP_SETUP=0
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    SKIP_APP_SETUP=1
    echo "User-upload mode enabled; skipping repository setup."
elif [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
    fi

    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] || [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    PROJECT_ENTRY="$(find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.ptero' ! -name '.local' -print -quit)"
    if [ -n "${PROJECT_ENTRY}" ]; then
        echo "/mnt/server already contains project files."
        if [ ! -f .git/config ]; then
            echo "Files exist but no Git configuration was found; stopping to avoid overwriting them."
            exit 10
        fi

        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
            echo "Pulling the latest repository changes."
            git pull
        else
            echo "The existing Git origin differs from GIT_ADDRESS; leaving repository files unchanged."
        fi
    else
        echo "Cloning repository into the prepared server directory."
        TARGET_BRANCH="${BRANCH:-}"
        if [ -z "${TARGET_BRANCH}" ]; then
            TARGET_BRANCH="$(git ls-remote --symref "${GIT_ADDRESS}" HEAD | {
                read -r marker ref_name _
                if [ "${marker}" == "ref:" ]; then
                    echo "${ref_name#refs/heads/}"
                fi
            })"
        fi
        if [ -z "${TARGET_BRANCH}" ]; then
            echo "Could not determine the repository default branch. Set the Install Branch field manually."
            exit 11
        fi

        git init
        git remote add origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
        git fetch --depth 1 origin "${TARGET_BRANCH}"
        git checkout -B "${TARGET_BRANCH}" FETCH_HEAD
    fi
else
    echo "GIT_ADDRESS is empty while USER_UPLOAD is disabled."
    echo "Provide a Git Repo Address, or set User Uploaded Files to 1 for manual uploads."
    exit 12
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/run.js ]; then
    cat >/mnt/server/run.js <<'NODE_RUNNER'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
process.env.TZ = 'Asia/Jakarta';

/**
 * Function to start a command process.
 * @param {string} cmd - The command to execute.
 */
function start(cmd) {
   try {
      const childProcess = spawn(cmd, [], {
         stdio: ['inherit', 'inherit', 'inherit', 'ipc'],
      });

      childProcess.on('error', (error) => {
         console.error('Error starting process:', error.message);
      });
   } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error:', error.message);
   }
}

start('bash');
NODE_RUNNER
    echo "Created /mnt/server/run.js."
else
    echo "Keeping the existing /mnt/server/run.js."
fi

echo "System tools are provided by the centralized Docker image."
node --version
python3 --version
ffmpeg -version | head -n 1
yt-dlp --version
cloudflared --version

if [ "${SKIP_APP_SETUP}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "Tool installation complete."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Installing Node.js packages."
if [ -n "${NODE_PACKAGES}" ]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev
fi

echo "Installation complete."
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description:
GitHub Repo to clone

I.E. https://github.com/parkervcp/repo_name

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

variables.name: Additional Node packages
variables.description:
Install additional node packages.

Use spaces to separate.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Uninstall Node packages
variables.description:
Uninstall node packages.

Use spaces to separate.

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description: Command used to start the Node.js project. The default runs the start script from package.json. Examples: npm start, npm run dev, node index.js, or npx tsx src/index.ts.

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: 0 = off, 1 = on. Restart the server after changing this setting. cloudflared is supplied by the centralized Docker image. Connection and error logs: .cloudflare/tunnel.log.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Connector token for a remotely-managed tunnel. Keep this value secret and only fill it when Cloudflare Tunnel is enabled.
